title: Can LLMs Improve Their Own Harness? A Controlled Study on ARC-AGI-3
why: Direct study of whether frontier LLMs can construct and revise their own symbolic harness (perception, memory, tools, recovery, inference allocation) on ARC-AGI-3 via a fixed coding bootstrap with two full-codebase revisions and held-out evaluation—core harness RSI question.
mechanism: Agent builds and revises its own task harness codebase; retained changes are harness software (not weights).
evaluation_signal: Author-reported: five development games then evaluation of every harness version on ARC-AGI-3 interactive settings (abstract only).
retrieval_notes: New submission on Fri 23 Oct cs.AI listing; abstract+metadata verified via arXiv API and abs HTML; full PDF unread.

title: HERD: Harness-Evolving Recursive Distillation for Continual Learning
why: Hybrid continual-learning loop that continually refines harness-side skills/prompts and high-residual examples, then distills into parameters—explicit harness evolution with retention under fixed memory/compute budgets.
mechanism: Harness-side skill refinement + residual example memory; drift-constrained distillation internalizes experience into weights while harness keeps evolving.
evaluation_signal: Author-reported: 25-stage TRACE+17 stream; compares acquisition vs forgetting vs general-capability retention under fixed budgets (abstract only).
retrieval_notes: New on cs.CL (cross-listed to cs.AI) Fri listing; API+abs verified; PDF unread.

title: AgenticEvolve: Evolutionary Program Search with Persistent Language Model Agents that Design and Run Experiments
why: Replaces single-shot LLM variation in evolutionary program search with persistent island agents that design/run experiments between evaluations—self-improving search harness for program/heuristic discovery.
mechanism: Persistent LM agents per island design and run experiments on candidate programs; retained improvements are evolved programs plus agent experiment practice.
evaluation_signal: Author-reported: two heuristic design tasks × three LLMs; vs No-analysis and OpenEvolve on hidden/unseen instances; fewer evaluations to baseline quality (abstract only).
retrieval_notes: Cross-list on Fri cs.AI (primary cs.NE); API+abs verified; repo URL from arXiv comment; PDF unread.
